_comment: OneLive KPI registry — the EDITABLE source of truth for tools/kpi_report.py. To change WHICH KPIs are tracked, their TARGETS, or their FREQUENCY: edit this file only, then `python tools/kpi_report.py --print` to verify. See docs/strategy/ONE_LIVE_KPI_FRAMEWORK_v1.md 'How to change a KPI' for the 3-step recipe. Adding a genuinely NEW measurement (one `compute` doesn't already cover) still needs one Python function registered in tools/kpi_report.py's _COMPUTE_FUNCTIONS map — everything else (target/frequency/area/owner/enable/disable, or a new KPI reusing an existing compute or 'manual_gap') is JSON-only. Schema per entry: id (unique), area, metric (display name), kind (leading|lagging), target (human string), direction (higher_better|lower_better|boolean|informational), frequency (per_run|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly), owner, enabled (bool), compute (a key in _COMPUTE_FUNCTIONS, or the literal 'manual_gap' for a not-yet-instrumented KPI — 'manual_gap' entries also require 'why' and 'trigger'). Loaded and validated by tools.kpi_report.load_kpi_registry(); a malformed or unknown-compute entry fails LOUD (exit 2), never silently skipped.
